method: Built-in image generation: background extension of original showcase photograph

prompts.square: Edit target: the supplied BiteScribe laptop-and-phone product photograph. Produce one photo-only Facebook/Instagram advertising image at 1080 by 1080 pixels, exact 1:1 square. Preserve the existing laptop and phone together, their relative arrangement, all existing device geometry, and the contents of BOTH app screens exactly as supplied. Do not redraw or reinterpret UI, words, icons or numbers. Fit the complete supplied photo within the new canvas, retaining both devices and the keyboard currently visible, and naturally OUTPAINT ONLY the room background and wooden tabletop as needed to fill the requested aspect ratio edge-to-edge. Warm soft window light, neutral cream interior, softly blurred plants, consistent tabletop perspective and shadows. Product pair remains the focal point, comfortably centered; for portrait put the pair in the middle with natural room above and tabletop below, leaving outer top and bottom edges free of critical product content for placement overlays. No graphic design: NO added text, slogans, headlines, CTA buttons, icons, logos, borders, cards, gradient panels, labels or watermarks. Existing text INSIDE device screens is retained. No cropping off either device, no extra devices. This is a faithful background extension of the original photograph, not a new product concept. Output a single finished photo, not multiple panels.
